'''True Sabacc''' is a planned [[GEMP]] game mode for the Star Wars CCG sabacc mini-game. Players draw two to six cards and try to total as close to 11 as possible without going over. Card values are destiny numbers. Full rules are in the [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] under Sabacc.<ref name="ar2023">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf Players Committee Advanced Rulebook] (2023), Appendix C, Sabacc.</ref>

This mode is playable as its own table. It is also the last tiebreaker for tournaments on this instance, after victory points, Life Force differential, Lost Pile count, and hand count. Tournament Guide 2.2 describes that last-resort hand.<ref name="tg22">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Star-Wars-CCG-Tournament-Guide-2.2.pdf Star Wars CCG Official Tournament Guide 2.2] (revised July 2018), §3.8.1.</ref> How this instance intends to seat both uses is on [[GEMP planned features]].

Interrupt cards that start a sabacc hand during a regular CCG game include [[Cloud City Sabacc]], [[Dune Sea Sabacc]], [[Jabba's Palace Sabacc]], and [[Trooper Sabacc]].

<span id="Planning:_Cloud_City_Sabacc_setting"></span>
== Planning: game mode outline ==

''Status: planning. This section records intent only. Nothing is decided, including the name.''

[[Bill Bisco]] plans True Sabacc with a theme for each sabacc variant in the card game: [[Cloud City Sabacc]], [[Dune Sea Sabacc]], [[Jabba's Palace Sabacc]], and [[Trooper Sabacc]]. Each theme has a Light Side and a Dark Side version. Each table has a matching dealer, and players bet gold and silver in hands against the dealer or other players. Progression leads up to Lando. The full outline is on [[Sabacc game mode outline]].

=== Music ===

Each location is planned to have its own music. The first item is a demo song for the Cloud City casino; see [[Sabacc game mode music]].
